sentence_list.content: President: Virgilio Barco Vargas (1986–1990). Vice President: N/A.
Colombian conflict.
23 January – The 1987 South American U-20 Championship begins in Armenia.
8 February – The 1987 South American U-20 Championship ends, Colombia wins.
28 February – Santa Clara massacre: Armed men break into a house in Santa Clara, Fundación, Magdalena and kidnap a family of 4 and execute them in Puerto Piedra.
The perpetrators are never determined.
3 March – San Sebastián massacre: 5 people are murdered in rural San Sebastián, Cauca by armed men and are buried in a mass grave.
The perpetrators are never determined.
5-6 March – 1987 Ecuador earthquakes: 6.0-7.2 Mw.
13 April – Cimitarra Massacre: The village of Número Siete in Cimitarra, Santander is attacked by around 90 members of the  Self-Defense Forces of Puerto Boyacá, who bring with them a list of names.
They gather 14 people they accuse of being leftist guerilla sympathizers and execute them by the Carare River bank.
10-22 June – The 37th Vuelta a Colombia is held, Pablo Wilches wins.
11 July – The Colombia national football team plays Argentina in the third place play off leading up to the 1987 Copa América.
Colombia wins 2 to 1.
23 August – Popayán massacre.
September – El Porvenir massacre.
11 October –  Jaime Pardo Leal, 1986 presidential candidate for the Patriotic Union, is assassinated in a drive-by shooting between La Mesa and Bogotá.
21 November – Narco-trafficker Jorge Ochoa is captured in El Cerrito, Valle del Cauca.
30 December – Jorge Ochoa is released from prison on a habeas corpus petition.
The Simón Bolívar Guerrilla Coordinating Board (CGSB) is formed.
27 August – Juan David Díaz, footballer.
27 September – Karen Carreño, model.
1 December – Valeria Santa, actor.
11 October – Jaime Pardo Leal, union leader, lawyer, and politician (b. 1941).
Events of 1987 in Colombia.
